You will never believe what I'm going to tell you right now. I have a job for you! Alright, jokes aside, the Reshala guy wants to jump head first into a new business. And believe me, I don't want this fucker in there. I found out this punk's planning a meeting with one of my partners with ties to the big land. Thing is, we only know the meeting spot, but we don't know when they're gonna sort their shit out. So I hired a trustworthy sniper to crash the meeting when it happens. Except that now he's in his position out there all the fucking time, can't even go down to take a piss. What's more, the stash I set up for him at the lookout spot was found by the Scavs, and they looted everything clean. You think you can drop off the rest of the gear? It's at the plant with three large pipes in the middle of the industrial zone. It's got some metal scaffolding or something around it... Hide it all over that scaffolding, alright? Shit, man, of fucking course I'll pay you for it. Work hard, and you'll earn hard, hehe.}} ==Objectives== * Stash a [[Lobaev Arms DVL-10 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle|DVL-10 sniper rifle]] at the specified spot on [[Customs]] * Stash a [[DVL-10 7.62x51 10-round magazine|DVL-10 magazine]] at the specified spot on [[Customs]] * Stash an [[ELCAN SpecterDR 1x/4x scope|ELCAN SpecterDR scope]] at the specified spot on [[Customs]] * Stash a pack of any [[7.62x51mm NATO|7.62x51 ammo]] at the specified spot on [[Customs]] ==Rewards== * +11,400 [[EXP]] * [[Ragman]] Rep '''+0.03''' * 105,000 Roubles ** 110,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 1 ** 120,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 2 * 1× [[IOTV Gen4 body armor (High Mobility Kit, MultiCam)]] {{quote|So, you seen my gunslinger?
